instructions: Every provision is accounted for by an op, a disposition or an escalation.
Cite exact words (verbatim quotations with unit id, document and page).
Say 'insufficient evidence' (escalate, or a disposition 'unresolved' with the reason) rather than complete a plausible answer.
Facts, assumptions and interpretations are separate statements; never merge them.
Unknown structures and unsupported change types are escalated, never turned into guessed operations.
The reference below is pattern drafter output, unverified: check it against the evidence before using any of it.
Read targets as they stand before this addendum: get_unit(unit_id, stage=<previous_stage>); quote that text.

A no_effect disposition on words that amend, oblige or except never verifies: a printed change needs its op; otherwise quote, in the reason, the words that show it changes nothing (a person confirms it).

provisions.heading: Wadi Sirhan Independent Sewage Treatment Plant
provisions.text: This Addendum amends the definition of Estimated Project Cost, the financial capacity requirement in Volume I Clause 8.4 and the delay liquidated damages in Volume V Clause 18.1, relaxes the velocity limit for the treated effluent transmission main, amends Section 5.1 of Addendum No. 1, reissues the technical evaluation table to add a criterion for energy efficiency, divides Volume I Clause 11.3 into two Clauses, makes a conditional amendment to Volume II Clause 1.4, adds a Declaration of Beneficial Ownership (Form 4-H) which all Bidders may submit through the Portal within five Working Days after the Proposal Due Date, and responds to clarification requests 15 to 20. This Addendum forms part of the RFP Documents and takes precedence in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2. Bidders shall acknowledge receipt in Form 4-A. All other terms of the RFP Documents remain unchanged.

If PCOD is not achieved by the Scheduled PCOD, the Project Company shall pay to the Authority delay liquidated damages at the rate of SAR 180,000 for each day of delay.

Volume II Clause 5.3 is amended by adding at the end: ‘Glass reinforced plastic pipe of an equivalent pressure class is acceptable for the buried sections of the transmission main, subject to the whole-life cost comparison required by this…
A Proposal scoring less than seventy (70) marks out of one hundred (100) at the technical evaluation shall not proceed to commercial evaluation and its Envelope B shall be returned unopened.
The Authority will provide the site free of encumbrance, together with a grid connection point at the site boundary. All other utilities shall be procured by the Project Company.
In the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy between or within the RFP Documents, the following order of precedence shall apply, the first named prevailing:

provision.description: unit id of the addendum provision this item answers

target.description: unit id (or group id) the item changes or concerns

payload.description: amendment_op: an amend.Op; disposition: an amend.Disposition; row_reading: {row, interpretation}; row_new: {row}; issue: {text, owner, short, theme}; clarification: {gap, proposed_question, practical_impact, interim_handling, decision_owner}; escalation: {why, what_is_unsupported}
payload.title: Payload

previous_value.description: the value as it stands in the current state
previous_value.title: Previous Value

dependencies.description: ids of units, rows or ops this item relies on
dependencies.title: Dependencies

statements.description: ids of the statements this item depends on
statements.title: Statements

model_rationale.description: free text; never read by code
model_rationale.title: Model Rationale

words.description: the exact words, verbatim, as printed in the unit (or the cell) at the stated state; for an image reading, the SOURCE text (Arabic as printed), never the translation
words.title: Words

evidence_build_id.title: Evidence Build Id

decisions_sha256.description: sha256 of the decisions file; null when there is none

assumptions_sha256.description: sha256 of the assumptions file (calendar, holidays, counting policy, durations)
assumptions_sha256.title: Assumptions Sha256

activity_templates_sha256.description: sha256 of the activity templates file
activity_templates_sha256.title: Activity Templates Sha256

readings_sha256.description: one sha256 over the approvals file and the reading files
readings_sha256.title: Readings Sha256

amendments_sha256.description: one sha256 over the amendment files of the addenda before the working stage (all of them when there is none)
amendments_sha256.title: Amendments Sha256

unrecorded_crops_sha256.description: one sha256 over the image crops the units name that BUILD_MANIFEST.json does not record; null when it records every one
unrecorded_crops_sha256.title: Unrecorded Crops Sha256

schema.title: ProposalSet (fields the proposer fills)
schema.description: Return exactly one JSON object of this shape. verification_status and validation are written by the controller; any value you supply is overwritten.

interpretation.description: register.Interp fields: stage, quote, parameters, consequence, note (no pins: pins are machine-written)
interpretation.title: Interpretation

row.description: register.Row fields (id, group, scope, requirement, units, discipline, assessment, evidence, interpretations, confidence, confidence_reason, ...)
row.title: Row

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Rank units by token overlap with the query (deterministic; no embeddings). Returns unit ids, document, pages, kind and a snippet. Use get_unit for the full text.

tools.name: get_unit
tools.description: One unit: text as issued and effective text at a stage, cells, pages, status, the ops that changed or annotate it; for an image reading the source text, translation and match text separately.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Members of a table, form, list or section (e.g. VOL-II:T2-2) with cells, heading and notes.

tools.name: get_crop
tools.description: Path and sha256 of the native image and crops of an image-read unit (refused for text-layer units). A vision-capable provider is shown the image.

tools.name: compare_state
tools.description: What changed between two stages: requirements, stale rows, A3, programme, and every unit whose status, text, cells or annotations differ.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Approved date calculations only (VOL-I 2.4 calendar): kind relative_date {anchor_date, offset, unit, direction, purpose} gives every counting reading; working_days_between {from, to}; add_working_days {date, n}; is_working_day {date}; printed_date {unit_id, stage}.

tools.name: simulate_amendment
tools.description: Dry-run proposed ops (amend.Op objects) and dispositions for an addendum through the amendment engine over the state before it. Returns per-op validity with check records (C21-C27), C47, scope leak, coverage, changed units and C46 needs. Nothing is persisted.

tools.name: simulate_programme
tools.description: The A5 programme at a stage, read-only: milestones and infeasible chains.

tools.name: validate_proposal
tools.description: The controller's validation of one ChangeProposal (or a whole ProposalSet) against the current state; returns the controller's verification statuses. Writes nothing.
